scope: post-fix stability review — second pass after CORR-001..011 fixes

findings.title: qualityKwargs built but never passed to evaluateNovelQuality
findings.description: novelQualityCheckEndpoint builds qualityKwargs from body fields (quality_level, quality_mode, etc.) but evaluateNovelQuality only accepts content — kwargs are dead code. Users setting these fields have no effect.
findings.fix: Renamed qualityKwargs to qualityOptions with camelCase keys (qualityLevel, qualityMode, etc.) matching evaluateNovelQuality's options parameter. Passed as second argument.

findings.title: Decision threshold mismatch: writing.ts uses 40 for REWRITE but critic.ts uses 60
findings.description: writing.ts: totalScore >= 40 ? 'REWRITE' : 'HUMAN_REVIEW'. critic.ts: overallScore >= 60 ? 'REVISE' : 'REWRITE'. The 40 threshold creates a 'HUMAN_REVIEW' tier that doesn't exist in the critic engine, and REWRITE triggers earlier (40 vs 60).
findings.fix: Aligned with critic.ts: APPROVED >= 80, REVISE >= 60, REWRITE < 60. Removed undocumented HUMAN_REVIEW tier.

findings.title: Foreshadow state vs status property key mismatch
findings.description: foreshadowPlantEndpoint stores foreshadow state under key 'state' (graph.ts:134) but GraphEngine.getForeshadows queries by json_extract(properties, '$.status') (graph-engine.ts:1201). This causes foreshadowStatsEndpoint to always return zero counts for all states because the query never matches stored data.
findings.fix: Changed json_extract(properties, '$.status') to json_extract(properties, '$.state') to match the key used by foreshadowPlantEndpoint.

findings.title: characterProfileEndpoint reads nested properties as top-level
findings.description: characterProfileEndpoint reads role, personality, background, etc. directly from characterData but graphGetCharacter returns them nested inside properties sub-object. All profile fields would resolve to defaults (role='unknown', personality={}).
findings.fix: Extracted properties sub-object first, then read role/personality/etc from properties instead of top-level data. Also fixed characterDepthEndpoint with same pattern.

findings.title: foreshadowPlantEndpoint returns incomplete shape
findings.description: graphAddEntity calls engine.createEntity() which returns {id, status:'created'} but frontend expects full ForeshadowItem with description, state, planted_at, hints, harvested_at, importance, tags, metadata.
findings.fix: After graphAddEntity call, construct full ForeshadowItem return shape from stored properties and entityId.

findings.title: PluginPanel.tsx uses inline PluginInfo/PluginResult types diverging from api/plugins.ts
findings.description: PluginPanel.tsx declares its own PluginInfo and PluginResult interfaces instead of importing from api/plugins.ts. The types are now aligned (after fix) but future divergence risk exists since they are independently maintained.
findings.impact: Maintenance burden — types may diverge again in future changes
findings.suggestion: Import PluginInfo and PluginResult from '../../api/plugins' instead of declaring inline duplicates

findings.title: graphGetForeshadows signature inconsistency: service vs endpoint parameter names
findings.description: graph.ts endpoint passes (status ?? undefined, chapter, scope) but graphGetForeshadows service function signature takes (status?: string | null, chapter?, scope?). The null vs undefined semantics differ.
findings.impact: Low — function handles both null and undefined, but semantic confusion for future readers
findings.suggestion: Standardize: either the service accepts null explicitly and endpoint passes null, or service accepts undefined and endpoint converts

findings.title: PluginPanel.tsx silently swallows all API errors
findings.description: Both loadPlugins and executePlugin have empty catch blocks (catch {}). If the backend is down or returns unexpected shapes, the component silently shows empty state with no user feedback or retry mechanism.
findings.impact: Users see empty UI with no indication of failure; no retry path
findings.suggestion: Add error state to UI (toast or inline error message) and optionally a retry button

findings.title: writing.ts SSE buffer accumulates without backpressure
findings.description: writingStreamEndpoint accumulates all SSE chunks into a single array (sseEvents) with a 5MB cap. For long generations, this creates a memory spike before returning the full response.
findings.impact: OOM risk for very long generations approaching 5MB; latency until first byte is the full generation time
findings.suggestion: Known architectural limitation (HTTP response model). Consider chunked transfer encoding or WebSocket for true streaming
